# Session preparation

## Installing R packages

You will need to install the following packages from CRAN:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
install.packages(c("patchwork", "dplyr", "tidyr", "suncalc", "remotes", "tidyverse", 
  "classInt"))
```

And from GitHub:

- gapFinder
```{r, eval = FALSE}
remotes::install_github("IMOS-AnimalTracking/gapFinder", build_opts = c("--no-resave-data", "--no-manual"), build_vignettes = TRUE)
```
- remora
```{r, eval = FALSE}
remotes::install_github('IMOS-AnimalTracking/remora', build_vignettes = TRUE, dependencies = TRUE)
```

We will also need to set our working directory to the folder containing the workshop materials:
```{r}
setwd("/Users/yuriniella/Documents/GitHub/IMOS ATF PROFILE/Innovasea---IMOS-Telemetry-Workshop-2026")

options(width = 70) # Console width setting
```

## 1.2. Receiver performance and diagnostics - gapFinder package walkthrough

### 1.2.1. Load packages

```{r gapfinder-packages}
library(FathomR)
library(gapFinder)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(suncalc)
```

### 1.2.2. Load packages

#### Load receiver logs

```{r gapfinder-load}
fathom_dets <- parse_fathom_files('Data/gapFinder/Fathom',
    output = 'list')
```

#### Match deployment metadata

Describe the metadata columns required...

```{r, results='hide'}
dets_sort <- match_meta(input = fathom_dets,
  path_meta = "Data/gapFinder/Receiver metadata.csv",
  receiver_id = "receiver_name",
  transmitter_id = "transmit_id",
  type = "type",
  station_name = "station_name",
  deploy_datetime = "receiver_deployment_datetime", 
  recover_datetime = "receiver_recovery_datetime",
  lat = "receiver_deployment_latitude",
  lon = "receiver_deployment_longitude",
  delay = "delay",
  tz = "UTC")

names(dets_sort)
```

#### Daily transmissions and detections

```{r gapfinder-daily-dets}
daily_dets <- get_daily_dets(input = dets_sort, 
		circadian = TRUE,
    path_meta = "Data/gapFinder/Receiver metadata.csv",
    receiver_id = "receiver_name", 
    transmitter_id = "transmit_id", 
    delay = "delay",
    station_name = "station_name", 
    type = "type",
    deploy_datetime = "receiver_deployment_datetime",  
    recover_datetime = "receiver_recovery_datetime", 
    lat = "receiver_deployment_latitude", 
    lon = "receiver_deployment_longitude", 
    tz = "UTC")

head(daily_dets)
```

#### Estimating daily detection ranges

Calculate daily ranges...

```{r gapfinder-daily-ranges}
daily_ranges <- get_daily_ranges(input = daily_dets, 
        diag_data = dets_sort, 
        parallel = TRUE)

names(daily_ranges)
daily_ranges$global # Global parameters
head(daily_ranges$ranges)
head(daily_ranges$curves)
```

Daily logistic curves...

```{r gapfinder-curves, fig.height=12}
dates <- seq(as.Date("2022-12-29", tz = "UTC"),
  as.Date("2023-01-02", tz = "UTC"),
  1)

dates

for (i in 1:length(dates)) {
  aux_plot <- ggplot() + theme_bw() +
    geom_line(data = subset(daily_ranges$curves, 
      station_name == "MIL 10" &
      date == dates[i]),
        aes(x = x, 
          y = p),
         linewidth = 1, 
         colour = 'dodgerblue') +
    geom_point(data = subset(daily_ranges$ranges,
      station_name == "MIL 10" &
      date == dates[i]),
        aes(x = max_distance_detected, 
          y = daily_efficiency),
        size = 3
      ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, lty = 'dashed') +
    labs(x = "Distance (m)", y = "Detection prob (%)",
      title = paste("Date:", dates[i])) +
      facet_wrap(~circadian)
    # Combine plots
    if (i == 1) {
      plot_curve <- aux_plot
    } else {
      plot_curve <- plot_curve / aux_plot
    }
}

plot_curve
```

Diagnostics table

```{r gapfinder-diagnostics}
diag_ranges <- range_diag(input = daily_ranges, 
    station_order = c("MIL 10"))
as.data.frame(diag_ranges)
```

Plot daily ranges:

Describe the difference between raw and corrected ranges...

```{r gapfinder-ranges-plot}
ranges_long <- daily_ranges$ranges %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cor_range, range),
    names_to = "range_type",
    values_to = "range_value"
  )

plot_ranges1 <- ggplot(ranges_long) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = range_value,
      colour = range_type
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~circadian, nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Range (m)",
    colour = "",
    title = "MIL 10 daily ranges"
  )

plot_ranges2 <- ggplot(ranges_long) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      x = circadian, 
      y = range_value, 
      group = interaction(circadian, range_type),
      colour = range_type
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Range (m)",
    colour = ""
  )

plot_ranges <- (plot_ranges1 | plot_ranges2) + plot_layout(guides = 'collect')

plot_ranges
```

#### Environmental drivers of detection range

Add circadian periods to diagnostic data:

Describe how day/night is defined (nautical dawn and dusk) and why local time is used...

```{r gapfinder-circadian}
lat <- dets_sort$diag$receiver_deployment_latitude[1]
lon <- dets_sort$diag$receiver_deployment_longitude[1]

# Parse timestamps in UTC, then derive the local time and local date
dets_sort$diag <- dets_sort$diag %>%
  mutate(
    local_time = with_tz(Time, "Australia/Hobart"),
    date       = as.Date(local_time)   # local calendar date, used for the join
  )

# Sunrise and sunset for each local date at receiver deployment
sun <- getSunlightTimes(
  date = unique(dets_sort$diag$date),
  lat  = lat,
  lon  = lon,
  keep = c("nauticalDawn", "nauticalDusk"),
  tz   = "Australia/Hobart"
)

# Assign day/night categories
dets_sort$diag <- dets_sort$diag %>%
  left_join(
    sun %>% dplyr::select(date, nauticalDawn, nauticalDusk),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    circadian = case_when(
      local_time >= nauticalDawn & local_time < nauticalDusk ~ "day",
      TRUE ~ "night"
    )
  )

# Sanity check
table(dets_sort$diag$circadian, useNA = "ifany")
```

Plot diagnostic data and daily ranges:

```{r gapfinder-diag-plots, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
plot_eff <- ggplot() + theme_bw() + 
  geom_line(data = daily_ranges$ranges,
    aes(x = date, y = daily_efficiency)) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Efficiency (%)") +
  facet_wrap(~circadian, nrow = 2)

plot_temp <- ggplot() + theme_bw() + 
	geom_line(data = dets_sort$diag,
		aes(x = Time, y = as.numeric(`Ambient Temperature (deg C)`))) +
	labs(x = "Date", y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  facet_wrap(~circadian, nrow = 2)

plot_noise <- ggplot() + theme_bw() + 
	geom_line(data = dets_sort$diag,
		aes(x = Time, y = as.numeric(`Noise Mean (mV)`))) +
	labs(x = "Date", y = "Noise (mV)") +
  facet_wrap(~circadian, nrow = 2)

plot_diag <- plot_eff | plot_temp | plot_noise
```

```{r gapfinder-combined, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
plot_ranges / plot_diag
```
